answer: Admission auctions stop sybil farming. Each epoch offers 200 slots; agents bid POA, the top 200 win, and the zenith bid sets the clearing price. Winners pay into the reward pool, the nectar honest agents harvest. An attacker wanting 100 fake identities must outbid agents 100 times: at 40 POA a seat that is 4,000 POA for one reward. A reef breaks the flood: fakes pay full price per seat, while one honest agent pays once and takes its full share.
